title: GPT Scored-Format Construct Quality Audit (104 Inner-Ring Items)
surviving_audited_surface: banks/gpt-canonical.json (all 104 items identified in population-first.jsonl survive live)
decision_value_rationale: This audit evaluated 104 complex scored-format items and identified 31 items recommended for retirement (due to non-nursing specialist formulas such as SOFA score, RSBI, and corrected sodium, prompts asking learners to guess arbitrary 4-letter abbreviations, or unsolvable stems) and 14 items requiring surgical repair. The owner explicitly approved the retirement and repair findings. However, the execution was halted by a procedural violation (writing output to /tmp/population-first.jsonl which triggered BLOCKED_OUTPUT_CONTAMINATION). The actual mutations were never executed. All 104 items remain live in gpt-canonical.json today. Reviving this audit directly removes 31 confirmed construct-invalid questions from learner study.
current_decision: Retire 31 confirmed flawed questions and surgically repair 14 items in banks/gpt-canonical.json, removing invalid non-nursing specialist formulas and arbitrary abbreviation-recall items from the canonical exam bank.

prioritization.semantic_vs_deterministic: Semantic audit already 90% completed historically in ADJUDICATIONS.md; needs live verification pass and formal mutation work order.
prioritization.recommended_seat: Mixed pipeline: mechanical extraction / validation followed by independent content checker review and owner mutation approval.
prioritization.justification_over_simple_fix: High value because it removes 31 pre-identified clinically invalid questions from gpt-canonical.json that learners actively encounter in practice.

title: Campaign 16 Surviving 66 Case-Stage Boundary Exceptions
decision_value_rationale: Campaign 16 R4 repaired 385/451 case parts but explicitly deferred 66 parts that have answerableAfterStageId: null (revealsAllStages). In the runtime learner shell, answerableAfterStageId: null causes the question to reveal all preceding stages upfront, creating fail-open stage leakage. The R4 closeout explicitly designated these 66 surviving boundary exceptions as successor work. Verified on live disk that exactly 66/66 parts across 66 parent cases still exist and still have null anchors.
current_decision: Establish valid stage boundary anchors (assigning answerableAfterStageId to matching valid stage IDs) for all 66 surviving case parts across the 4 canonical banks, eliminating fail-open clinical data leakage in the learner shell.

prioritization.semantic_vs_deterministic: Mixed: deterministic parent case stage-ID extraction, followed by semantic clinical check of when each part is legitimately answerable based on unfolding client data.
prioritization.recommended_seat: Astra or Claude producer with whole-case packetization, verified by independent content checker.
prioritization.justification_over_simple_fix: These 66 parts represent the entire remaining fail-open stage-leakage surface in the canonical case study corpus.

title: 75 Strict-Only Legacy-Primary Case-Stage Anchor Findings (missingRequiredAnchor)
decision_value_rationale: Running npm run audit:stage-refs -- --strict flags 75 case parts with [missingRequiredAnchor]. In these items, the legacy question.stageId field is populated and matches a valid stage, but the modernized question.caseStudyContext.answerableAfterStageId property is null or missing. Unlike the 66 exceptions, these do not fail open in runtime if the runtime falls back to stageId, but they create schema/contract bifurcation and will fail if strict validation is enforced in CI.
current_decision: Execute a mechanical migration copying valid legacy stageId values into caseStudyContext.answerableAfterStageId for 75 parts, enabling strict case-stage validation in promotion CI gates.

prioritization.semantic_vs_deterministic: Deterministic: 100% mechanical migration script with schema validation.
prioritization.recommended_seat: Cheaper mechanical seat (e.g. script-driven execution checked by npm run audit:stage-refs -- --strict).
prioritization.justification_over_simple_fix: Eliminates legacy-to-modern schema drift across 75 items and allows gating all future PRs on strict stage-ref validation.

title: Early-Bank Semantic Audit — Coherence Track (Layer A 1,039 Candidate Pairs)
decision_value_rationale: Layer A keyword co-occurrence generation produced 1,039 potential contradiction pairs. The audit examined a 100-pair sample and found a 98% false-alarm rate (98 false positives, 2 valid items repaired). The remaining 939 pairs were deferred due to poor economics (hundreds of hours of manual review for ~1-2 minor issues). Later structured validation, bowtie answerability passes, and clinical reviews have already addressed genuine content contradictions. Reopening the raw keyword-pair list would yield almost exclusively false alarms with near-zero decision value.
current_decision: None (maintain closure; keyword co-occurrence is an unviable heuristic for contradiction detection).

title: Automated Browser Regression Baseline (Playwright / In-App Browser)
decision_value_rationale: AGENTS.md and PROJECT-HISTORY.md repeatedly identify the lack of headless browser automation as an open gap. Currently, UI/visual verification relies on manual smoke checks or unit renderer selfCheck tests. A headless Playwright regression suite covering core exam navigation, visual stimulus rendering (rhythm strips, burn maps, io_trend), and bilingual toggles would provide automated CI guarantees against UI regressions.
current_decision: Implement a headless browser test suite (Playwright or Puppeteer) in package.json and CI covering core user flows: study session startup, bilingual toggles, visual question rendering, and answer submission.

prioritization.justification_over_simple_fix: Provides permanent regression safety for all current and future visual renderers and learner shell features.

title: Unresolved Vital Sanity Bounds (DBP, MAP, Temp Floor, Lab SaO2)
evidence_paths: DECISIONS.md (Decision P26: Vital Sanity Ceilings and Temperature Formats)
decision_value_rationale: In DECISIONS.md P26, production sanity ceilings were enacted for SBP (400 mmHg), RR (150 /min), and SpO2 (0-100%). However, P26 explicitly recorded Status: REVISIT for: diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ceiling, mean arterial pressure (MAP) ceiling, core temperature absolute floor (below which human life is incompatible), and lab SaO2 vs pulse oximetry SpO2 floor distinction. A bank-wide survey of DBP, MAP, and temperature minima across banks/*.json would determine the exact bounds needed to close these remaining sanity checks.
current_decision: Enact calibrated allowlist bounds for DBP (e.g. 0-250 mmHg), MAP (e.g. 0-250 mmHg), and minimum body temperature (e.g. 75.0 °F / 23.9 °C) in src/audit/measurementAllowlist.ts based on an empirical bank survey.

prioritization.semantic_vs_deterministic: Deterministic: empirical survey of vital sign values in banks/*.json followed by allowlist configuration.
prioritization.recommended_seat: Mechanical script audit seat with clinical reference verification.
prioritization.justification_over_simple_fix: Closes the remaining parked audit checks in Decision P26, preventing unphysiological blood pressure and temperature values from entering banks.
